StudentCC and UniCC use separate contributor pools. Each panel uses its own average and standard deviation.

StudentCC groups totals by campus, semester, VTOP class and assessment stage. Internal /60 and final /100 pools stay separate. A complete final total selects the /100 comparison. Average and spread (SD) appear from the first contribution; grade predictions need at least two contributors and non-zero SD. With one contributor, SD is zero. StudentCC keeps fractional totals; UniCC rounds contributions upward.

Predicted grades apply VIT’s relative boundaries to the sample. Internal predictions assume the same percentage performance in the final exam. Use View grade ranges for the assumptions and pass requirements.

The 9+ CGPA count includes StudentCC participants who confirmed class tally sharing. Each participant is counted once per class across both assessment stages. It is a contributor count, not a full class census. Exact CGPA is never shared.

Sharing settings are in Profile. Sharing starts selected on the sign-in screen. Signing in applies the displayed choice. The Profile switch enables sharing directly. You can stop sharing and request removal at any time.
